The '''Delta-X technology testbed''' was a technology testbed from which the [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7 ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor]] was ultimately descended. It was built by [[Kuat Systems Engineering/Legends|Kuat Systems Engineering]].<ref name="FDCR" />
